scope_definition: routes.discipline IN ('alpine','mountaineering') AND routes.id LIKE 'wa_%' AND routes.area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas WHERE area_type = 'peak'), ordered by routes.id ASC
scope_note: area_type = 'peak' excludes crags/walls (e.g. The Dikes, Summertime Crag) that carry an alpine/mountaineering discipline tag but are actually short cragging routes, not mountaineering objectives — out of scope per audit instructions.

batches.note: wa_big_kangaroo_southwest_rib flagged: its own id implies a route ('Southwest Rib') that belongs to a different peak entirely; row content is correct for Big Kangaroo's real 'West Face/West Route' but the id itself needs a human rename decision, not auto-fixed.

Two significant structural flags this batch, neither auto-fixed: wa_cascade_peak_east_ridge is a half-corrected row (overview rewritten to describe Cascade Peak's real NW Chimney route, but aspect/face/approach/corrections/seasonal_guidance still describe the previously-conflated Johannesburg Mountain East Ridge); wa_boston_peak_southwest_face duplicates its SE Face sibling's beta almost verbatim while its own fa/corrections fields describe a different, real West Face route — internally incoherent about which route it documents. Both need a human rewrite/split decision, not a field patch.

Cross-referenced sibling routes on the same peak (Unicorn Peak, Chimney Rock) directly from the DB to confirm two elevation errors: wa_classic_route_2's summit waypoint (6,867 ft) was the sole outlier against 3 other Unicorn Peak routes and Wikipedia (all 6,971 ft); wa_chimney_rock_west_face's high_point_ft (7,727 ft) matched its sibling East Face route but actually belongs to Chimney Rock's separate main/central summit, not the lower South Summit (7,440 ft, confirmed via Wikipedia) that this specific route's own name/waypoints/approach text describe climbing. Also repeated the exact 'Chiwawa/Entiat Ranger Districts' nonexistent-district error found and fixed for Bonanza Peak in batch 4, this time on wa_chiwawa_mountain_southwest -- same fix applied (Wenatchee River Ranger District).

Two more id/name-mismatch cases in the same family as batch 3's wa_big_kangaroo_southwest_rib: wa_colonial_peak_northeast's id says 'northeast' but the row (name, overview, face, waypoints) consistently describes the peak's real standard route, 'West Ridge / Colonial Glacier'; wa_corteo_peak_southeast_face's id says 'southeast_face' but the row describes the real standard 'Southwest Ridge / Standard Route'. Both flagged for a human rename decision, not auto-fixed. Also found and fixed a new pattern: Kimchi Suicide Volcano (Colfax Peak) had a null top-level grade despite already having verified ice_grade (AI4+) and rock_grade (M5) on file -- filled from the row's own verified sub-fields rather than external data.
